title: Luscious Aerated Italian Freekeh Pasta
description: A pungent, aerated, date-night Italian dish featuring freekeh, confit-tomato, and high-protein ingredients, cooked in a tandoor clay pot.

ingredients.name: Italian Seasoning
ingredients.notes: dried herbs like thyme, oregano, basil

instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 400°F (200°C).
In a blender or food processor, puree the confit tomato with garlic, olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the freekeh and Italian seasoning.
Add the guanciale slices to the bowl and toss to coat.
Transfer the freekeh mixture to the preheated tandoor clay pot.
While the freekeh is roasting, prepare the egg foam by whisking the eggs in a separate bowl.
Add a pinch of salt and pepper to the egg mixture and whisk until frothy.
Remove the tandoor clay pot from the heat and carefully pour the egg foam over the freekeh.
Return the pot to the heat and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the egg foam is set.
Serve immediately, garnished with grated Parmesan and chopped fresh basil.
Optional: sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese and serve with a side of garlic bread.
